description: List the plenary sittings of the Sejm (posiedzenia Sejmu: numbered meetings of the whole chamber, each lasting one or more days) in a term, with number, title and dates. Planned sittings that have no number yet have number 0. The number is the `proceeding` or `sitting` parameter of get-proceeding, get-votings, get-voting, get-transcripts and get-mp-votings, and the dates are the days of the sitting. Agendas are returned by get-proceeding.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; all by default

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-proceedings

number.description: Sitting number, the `proceeding`/`sitting` parameter of other tools

nextOffset.description: Pass as `offset` to get the next page; absent on the last page

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

offset.description: Number of matching items skipped before this page

total.description: Number of matching items on all pages

title: List plenary sittings
